title: Worksheet 11: A Debugging Story (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Maria wrote a program that was supposed to add two numbers entered by the user and display the total. When she ran the program, she typed in 5 and 3, expecting the answer 8. Instead, the program displayed "53" on the screen. Maria realized her program had a bug — an error in the code that causes it to behave incorrectly. After looking closely at her code, she discovered the problem: her program had been treating the numbers as text (called "strings") instead of as actual numbers. When computers combine two pieces of text, they simply stick them together, which is why "5" and "3" became "53" instead of being mathematically added. Maria fixed the bug by changing her code so the program would treat the user's input as numbers instead of text before doing the addition. This process of finding and fixing an error in code is called debugging.
